name: spleen-2.1.0
purpose: The bitmap font of the display's console (plan step C2.2, RFC 0020 section 28): Spleen's 8 by 16 BDF, read by the display service from the boot package and by the host to render the frame it expects of the display; the release by the SHA-256 of its tarball, the LICENSE file shipped beside the font. Spleen is Frederic Cambus's, under the BSD 2-Clause license, which the tarball's LICENSE states and setup requires.
